_README: IMAGE n in 369-attendance-hr-manual.md -> the file below. Drop the capture into this folder under exactly that name and rebuild; nothing in the Markdown changes.
A slot with no file on disk still renders a bordered plate and caption.
Shoot on the phone in portrait, signed in as an HR user (HR tab visible). Do not include real personal data.

1.capture: HAVE IT. HR tab for a user with leave and WFH rights: Your HR page guide folded, APPROVALS with Leave requests (2) and Work from home requests (1), Cancellation requests with no badge, TODAY boxes on Present, bottom bar Home / HR / Profile.

2.capture: HR tab with the yellow Your HR page box tapped open so its four numbered reminders show, APPROVALS rows visible beneath.

3.capture: HAVE IT. HR tab for an HR Officer with no approval rights: guide folded, TODAY section only, no APPROVALS section.

4.capture: HAVE IT. HR tab for a Leave Manager without WFH rights: Leave requests and Cancellation requests (badge 1), no Work from home requests row, TODAY below.

5.capture: HAVE IT. All Leave Requests on the Pending chip with the How to approve leave guide open, 2 requests line, a Casual 2-day card and a Comp Off half-day card, both Pending.

6.capture: HAVE IT. Pending Comp Off leave request: Dates, Days Half day, Paid / unpaid 0.5 / 0, Earned on, Comp-off balance, Submitted, REASON, Reject and Approve buttons.

7.capture: HAVE IT. Pending two-day Casual leave request with Paid / unpaid 1 / 1, REASON, Reject and Approve buttons.

8.capture: HAVE IT. Approve this request? window over a Comp Off request, with Cancel and Approve.

9.capture: HAVE IT. Reject this request? window over a Comp Off leave request with a reason typed into Reason for rejection. The test employee in this shot is named Administrator; retake with an ordinary test employee if preferred.

10.capture: Open a rejected leave request from the Rejected chip: status chip Rejected, Decided by row, REASON card, the red REJECTED BECAUSE box with the reason, and the line 'Already rejected — only a pending request can be decided.' at the bottom.

11.capture: HAVE IT. All Leave Requests on the Cancellation chip: one Casual 2-day card showing Approved with the orange Cancel asked chip.

12.capture: HAVE IT. Approved Casual leave with a pending cancellation: How to decide a cancellation guide, Approved by row, REASON, orange CANCELLATION REQUESTED box with Asked time, Keep leave and Approve cancellation buttons.

13.capture: HAVE IT. Approve the cancellation? window with the payroll warning, Back and Approve buttons.

14.capture: HAVE IT. Cancellation chip after the last request was decided: No cancellation requests / Nothing matches that filter this time.

15.capture: HAVE IT. Keep this leave? window with a reason typed into Why it stays; on-screen keyboard open.

16.capture: Open an approved leave with no cancellation request (Approved chip) and tap Cancel this leave: the Cancel this approved leave? window with the payroll warning and the Back and Cancel leave buttons, the Cancel this leave button visible behind it.

17.capture: HAVE IT. All WFH Requests on the Pending chip with the How to approve work from home guide, one Work from home card, Pending.

18.capture: HAVE IT. Pending work-from-home request: Date, Submitted, REASON, Reject and Approve buttons.

19.capture: HAVE IT. Approve this request? window for a work-from-home day, saying the employee will be able to check in from home on the date.

20.capture: HAVE IT. Reject this request? window over a work-from-home request with a reason typed in.

21.capture: HR tab scrolled to TODAY during working hours, with at least three people checked in: Present box selected and its rows listed beneath, ideally one row with a Late chip and one with a WFH chip. Use test employees only.
